trainer_findings.problem: Uniform flow MSE over all valid 50x14 chunk elements does not match receding-horizon execution of only the first action.
trainer_findings.required_fix: Expose unreduced loss, register early-horizon or first-action weighting as a controlled experiment, and log horizon plus arm/gripper decompositions.
trainer_findings.acceptance: Deployment-aligned validation and fixed-seed Gate4 improvement.

trainer_findings.problem: One-pass expert-only BC has no recovery distribution while closed-loop observations are policy-induced.
trainer_findings.required_fix: Add revisioned recovery data or DAgger with a state-conditioned oracle; never label deviated states with time-indexed expert actions.
trainer_findings.acceptance: Recovery candidate outperforms the expert-only control on fixed reachable seeds.

trainer_findings.problem: Checkpoint selection uses zero noise and fixed flow time while deployment uses seeded standard-normal inference noise.
trainer_findings.required_fix: Select or at least rank checkpoints with a preregistered Gaussian noise-seed ensemble and retain zero-noise results separately.
trainer_findings.acceptance: Validation noise contract matches simulator inference and is reproducible.

trainer_findings.problem: Images are used, but state shuffling hurts MAE far more than image shuffling; n_obs_steps=1, image transforms disabled, vision frozen, state projection trainable.
trainer_findings.required_fix: Add per-module gradients, controlled augmentation and history ablations, then recovery data; keep backbone adaptation a separate axis.
trainer_findings.acceptance: Visual and state sensitivity are reported and closed-loop gains persist under controlled perturbations.

trainer_findings.problem: Batch1 to batch8 preserved 20000 exposures but reduced planned updates from 20000 to 2500 and changed the LR path; batch1 did not complete.
trainer_findings.required_fix: Compare equal-exposure and equal-update small runs before claiming batch equivalence.
trainer_findings.acceptance: Batch conclusion is supported by a completed controlled comparison.

trainer_findings.problem: Bounded-sine decoding is many-to-one; fixed overfit had 0.3325 right-gripper internal outside-support rate despite legal standard output.
trainer_findings.required_fix: Test an internal-support penalty or dedicated bounded gripper head with explicit endpoint coverage.
trainer_findings.acceptance: Legal outputs plus low internal outside-support rate and no gripper regression.

trainer_findings.problem: Formal action-repair runner has preflight, smoke and train modes but no tested formal batch8 resume path.
trainer_findings.required_fix: Add create-only resume with exact model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, dataset-view and next-batch identity checks.
trainer_findings.acceptance: Interrupted/resumed run matches uninterrupted control at the same final step.

trainer_findings.problem: eval_steps=0 and env_eval_freq=0; validation is post-hoc only at quarter checkpoints.
trainer_findings.required_fix: Add a small deterministic validation slice transactionally at registered checkpoint boundaries.
trainer_findings.acceptance: Every checkpoint carries an exact validation summary without hot-loop simulation.

trainer_findings.problem: save_freq=625 is not divisible by log_freq=10, so steps 625 and 1875 have no exact training metric row.
trainer_findings.required_fix: Enforce aligned frequencies or save exact metrics and resources with each checkpoint.
trainer_findings.acceptance: Every checkpoint has an exact same-step metric snapshot.

trainer_findings.problem: Gate4 lacks first reward step, object/EEF poses, first-deviation window and compact raw internal gripper traces.
trainer_findings.required_fix: Add non-gating trajectory traces and first-deviation extraction before another long furnace.
trainer_findings.acceptance: Every failed rollout has a bounded provenance-rich diagnostic window.

optimizer_findings.finding: AdamW, BF16 and XPU stayed finite; checkpoints and final scheduler endpoint were valid.
optimizer_findings.action: Do not attribute Gate4 failure to an optimizer crash.

optimizer_findings.finding: Logged grad_norm is the total norm returned by clipping and is preclip evidence; 21.93872 above threshold 10 does not prove clipping failure.
optimizer_findings.action: Log preclip and postclip norms, clipping coefficient/fraction, nonfinite counts, per-module norms and update ratios.

optimizer_findings.finding: Warmup excludes its endpoint and cosine uses absolute current_step, so nominal peak 1e-4 is not reached; maximum logged LR was 9.929468e-5.
optimizer_findings.action: Define nominal scale explicitly or shift cosine progress after warmup; add exact transition tests.

optimizer_findings.finding: One AdamW parameter group applies the same LR and decay to expert and projections, with no module-wise update evidence.
optimizer_findings.action: Instrument named modules before testing differential learning rates.
Record it explicitly; test stronger decay only as a separate controlled axis after T1-T4.
Treat EMA as a separate candidate experiment, not a repair.

optimizer_findings.finding: Pinned trainer calls scheduler step per microbatch; Faust accumulation was 1.
optimizer_findings.action: Before accumulation greater than one, prove LR advances only on real optimizer updates and not on skipped mixed-precision steps.
